Line regulation (1.07 V/V) and TC (2148 ppm/C) are failing because the loop amplifier M7 has almost no headroom. At TT its Vds is 0.075 V against a Vdsat of 0.069 V, so the loop drops out at low VDD and at cold.

Fix: tie M7's source to vss and size it in strong inversion so its Vgs (~0.85–0.9 V) holds n1 above e1 with margin. Then n1 and d2 are both referenced to ground, so the PMOS mirror Vds tracks VDD equally and line regulation improves.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "M7 (loop amp) sits at edge of saturation (Vds 0.075 V), so the loop collapses over VDD/temperature, causing 1 V/V line reg and huge TC. Ground M7's source and size it in strong inversion (Vgs≈0.88 V) so n1 stays above e1 with margin; n1 and d2 become ground-referenced, so the PMOS mirror Vds tracks VDD equally."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (2.5e-6, 1.2e-6, 6e-6),
    "k_r2":   (9.6, 7.5, 12.0),
    "gmid_n": (20, 12, 26),
    "Ln":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (16, 9, 20),
    "Lp":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),
    "gmid_7": (7.0, 4.0, 12.0),
    "L7":     (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    mQ = 4
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    def veb(i, m):
        return 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 * m / i)

    ve1 = veb(I, mQ)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.25, vsb=ve1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    # Loop amp in strong inversion, source grounded: Vgs ~0.85-0.9 V sets n1 above e1
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_7"], p["L7"], I, vds=0.7, vsb=0.0)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PTAT core: M1/M2 share gate d2; equal currents force Veb1 = Veb2 + I*R1
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "d2", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mQ)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "d2", "a", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N * mQ)
    # Loop amp: grounded-source NMOS, diode PMOS load M6 drives the mirror gate
    n.dev("M7", "pg", "n1", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.C("Cn1", "n1", "vss", 0.5e-12)
    # Output branch: Vref = Veb3 + I*R2
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mQ)
    # Start-up: if vref is low, sx goes high and MS pulls pg down
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    vref = ve1 + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 4 * I + 0.6e-6
    # n1 and d2 are ground-referenced, so the PMOS Vds all move with VDD;
    # residual error comes from finite loop gain and differing PMOS Vds.
    A1 = mn.gm / max(mn.gds + mp.gds, 1e-15)
    A2 = m7.gm / max(mp.gm, 1e-15)
    loop = max(A1 * A2, 1.0)
    eps = (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * p["gmid_p"]   # dI/I per V of Vds
    line = p["k_r2"] * UT * eps / loop + (vref - ve1) * eps * 0.1 + 1e-3
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": 15.0,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
